keyDates.text: DHS submitted final rule eliminating F/J Duration of Status to OMB. Rule expected in Federal Register within weeks; effective date likely 30-60 days after publication.
Yale's 325th Commencement held on Old Campus. Over 1,600 graduates received degrees; honorary degrees awarded to eight individuals including swimmer Katie Ledecky.
Brown's 258th Commencement held on College Green. President Paxson presided over the first graduation since the December 2025 mass shooting; 1,825 bachelor's degrees conferred.
Princeton's 279th Commencement at Princeton Stadium. Ceremony for the undergraduate Class of 2026 and graduate degree candidates.

New tiered endowment excise tax (up to 8%) takes effect for institutions with June 30 fiscal year-end under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act. Harvard, Yale, Princeton, MIT, and Stanford face the highest rate.
Student loan changes from the One Big Beautiful Bill Act take effect, including elimination of Grad PLUS loans, caps on Parent PLUS loans, and consolidation of repayment plans.
DHS Duration of Status final rule expected to apply to new international students entering the US. PhD candidates, STEM graduate students, and 5+ year programs most affected.
Harvard-Trump federal funding appeal awaits oral arguments at the First Circuit. Government seeks reinstatement of $2.7B research funding freeze; Harvard's DOJ Title VI lawsuit also pending.

charts.title: Ivy League Acceptance Rates: Class of 2030 (Official & Estimated)
charts.sourceText: Yale Daily News, Columbia Spectator, Brown Daily Herald; estimates per Inside Higher Ed / admissions data trackers
charts.footnote: Harvard, Princeton, Penn, Dartmouth, and Cornell withheld official data for Class of 2030. Brown (5.35%), Columbia (4.23%), and Yale (4.24%) are officially confirmed rates. All others are estimates.

charts.title: Estimated Annual Endowment Tax Bills Under One Big Beautiful Bill Act (8% Tier)
charts.footnote: AEI estimates based on five-year IRS Form 990 data projected forward. Actual bills may vary. Cornell may not cross the $500K per-student threshold in the near term. Brown is not currently estimated to pay the top-tier rate.

charts.title: UChicago Operating Deficit Reduction Plan (FY2025 to FY2028 Projected)
charts.footnote: FY2025 actual deficit: $160M (down 44% from $288M in FY2024). FY2026 projected: $140M. FY2028 target: $0. Expansion to 9,000 undergraduates is a key revenue lever in the plan.

charts.title: F-1 Student Visa Issuances: Summer 2024 vs. Summer 2025 (June-August)
charts.sourceText: Inside Higher Ed analysis of State Department data, March 10, 2026
charts.footnote: Summer 2025 total F-1 visas: 186,160 - a decline of more than 100,000 from summer 2024. The 35.6% drop reflects the May-June 2025 State Department freeze on new visa interview scheduling for social media screening implementation.
